# Upgrading: renamed and removed names

The names a release renamed, reshaped or removed, under the Upgrade page section that explains
each, newest first: every composable, component, factory, type and constant the page lists as
gone, and the calls and options whose shape changed. When code written for an earlier version
fails on a name, find it in the **Was** column and write what **Now** says; the section's link
has the reasons and every step. The core skill's `references/renames.json`, in
`nuxt-backend`, holds the same entries as data.

- **renamed**: the same thing under a new name.
- **reshaped**: the same name, called or read differently.
- **removed**: gone. **Now** names what to use instead; a — means nothing replaces it.

`npx nuxt-backend upgrade` rewrites none of this: make each edit in the app's code yourself.
After it, run `npx nuxt-backend doctor`, and `npx nuxt-backend init --agents` to refresh the app's
agent files and skills.

| `sendTemplate` | `sendTemplate` | reshaped | `null` for an `otp` email, which leaves no record and has no status |
| `setupEmail` | `backend.email.sendSecret` | reshaped | a hand-written `components` object needs `backend.email.sendSecret`, which secret emails go through |

## [The packaged UI keeps the component contract](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#the-packaged-ui-keeps-the-component-contract)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `useBilling().products` | `useBilling().products` | reshaped | `{}` rather than `undefined` on a backend without `getConfiguredProducts` |
| `<AuthForm>` | `<AuthForm>` | reshaped | a busy button is `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`: match `[aria-disabled="true"]`, not `button:disabled` |
| `<ProfileSettings>` | `<ProfileSettings>` | reshaped | a busy save, submit or cancel button is `aria-disabled`, not `disabled` |
| `<SecuritySettings>` | `<SecuritySettings>` | reshaped | a busy button is `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`; `disabled` stays on "sign out other sessions" with no other session |
| `<AcceptInvitation>` | `<AcceptInvitation>` | reshaped | both answer buttons are `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`, while an answer is on its way |
| `<BillingHistory>` | `<BillingHistory>` | reshaped | the pager buttons are `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`, while a page loads, and the one pressed reads `labels.history.pageLoading`; `disabled` stays for no page further |
| `<UsageHistory>` | `<UsageHistory>` | reshaped | the pager buttons are `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`, while a page loads, and the one pressed reads `labels.usage.pageLoading`; `disabled` stays for no page further |
| `<PricingTable>` | `<PricingTable>` | reshaped | a `loading` slot and status while the plans load; every packaged component types its slots and keeps a busy button focusable (`aria-disabled`) |
